name: Gideon
summary: A man of Ophrah, the son of Joash, whom the angel of the LORD called to save Israel from the Midianites. With only three hundred men, trumpets and lamps, he saw the LORD put the whole army of Midian to flight.

key_moments.title: Called While Threshing Wheat
key_moments.description: Gideon was threshing wheat in hiding from the Midianites when the angel of the LORD came and told him the LORD was with him. Fire came up out of the rock and burned his offering, and Gideon built an altar to the LORD.

key_moments.title: Tearing Down Baal's Altar
key_moments.description: At the LORD's word, Gideon and ten servants pulled down his father's altar to Baal by night. When the men of the city wanted him killed, his father said Baal could defend himself, and Gideon was called Jerubbaal.

key_moments.title: Asks for a Sign with a Fleece
key_moments.description: Gideon asked God for a sign: dew on a fleece while the ground stayed dry, and the next night a dry fleece on wet ground. God did both.

key_moments.title: Defeats Midian with Three Hundred
key_moments.description: The LORD cut Gideon's army down to three hundred men who lapped water from their hands. At night they blew trumpets, broke their pitchers and held up lamps, and the LORD turned the enemy's swords against one another.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Rule over Israel
key_moments.description: The men of Israel asked Gideon to rule over them, but he said the LORD would rule over them. He made an ephod from the gold earrings they gave him, and all Israel turned to it, and it became a snare to Gideon and his house.
